profile.summary: A California dairy company that makes and sells milk, ice cream, butter, cottage cheese, sour cream, juice and other specialty products. It serves retail, foodservice, bulk and private-label customers. It has operated for more than a century and is owned by Foster Dairy Farms.

review.notes: Crystal Creamery's own contact page lists Crystal Creamery, Inc. at 529 Kansas Avenue, Modesto, CA, matching the agenda location, and a dairy supplier fits a K-12 grocery products bid. The about page supports the products, channels, 1901 founding and Foster Dairy Farms ownership; the phone and general business email appear on the contact page. I could not independently confirm the OUSD award itself because the search budget was exhausted.
